about_verbatim: We are a dog grooming salon on Portishead high street. Our aim is to create a welcoming, relaxed environment to ensure all dogs leave with a wagging tail. We welcome all breeds and sizes! All products are natural and vegan - only the best are used on your precious pups skin. We are fully insured and qualified, with a huge passion for grooming.
address: 48b High Street, Portishead, Bristol BS20 6EL, UK
prices: Not published anywhere found — site states 'Prices on request' once, in the services section.

review_themes.evidence: Joanna Presley: "Perfect from start to finish, I'm so impressed with the level of skill and the precision to attention of detail. My boy looked like a new dog with his new cut and not a single hair was missed."
Joanna Presley: Ella advised on his sensitive skin and a skin treatment "hugely helped the itching and licking of his paws."
Emma: "Ella did a fantastic job cleaning my dogs teeth... His teeth look like he's a puppy again with not a single speck of plaque in sight."
Sophie Keeley: her cavapoo's first groom with Erin — "she even text me half way through to let me know he was okay."
Erica Prothero: nail trim done within minutes, dog relaxed. Shauna King: "Did a fantastic wash on my German Shepard, highly recommend."
